title: PackageVersion
description: Metadata for a specific version of a package, including dependencies, scripts, and distribution information.

description.description: A short description of the package.

main.description: The entry point module for the package.

scripts.description: A mapping of script names to shell commands.

dependencies.description: A mapping of package names to semver ranges for runtime dependencies.

devDependencies.description: A mapping of package names to semver ranges for development dependencies.

peerDependencies.description: A mapping of package names to semver ranges for peer dependencies.

optionalDependencies.description: A mapping of package names to semver ranges for optional dependencies.

engines.description: A mapping of runtime names to semver ranges specifying compatible environments.

maintainers.description: List of maintainers for this version.

_npmVersion.description: The version of npm used to publish this package version.

_nodeVersion.description: The version of Node.js used to publish this package version.
